title: Dunham Formation
description: Brown-weathering, massive, irregularly-bedded gray to white dolostone

title: Cheshire Formation
description: Gray phyllitic (argillaceous) quartzites east of the Hinesburg Thrust with more massive and bedded quartzites with conspicuous smoky gray quartz pebbles west of this thrust

title: Pinnacle Formation, Green chloritic metagreywacke and schist member
Pinnacle Formation, Forestdale marble member
description: Brown-weathering dolomitic marble interlayered with green phyllites and phyllitic quartzites

title: Pinnacle Formation, Metawacke and phyllite member
description: Gray massive metawacke and grayish-green schist and phyllite

title: Pinnacle Formation, Undifferentiated member
description: Micaceous schist and phyllite with interlayers of metawacke

title: Pinnacle Formation, Metabasalt and volcaniclastic (greenstone) unit
Underhill Formation
description: Silvery-green albitic schist and phyllite; locally with interlayers of dolomite. quartzite, and metawacke
